patch_description: Restructure around a fully vectorized NumPy solver: pairwise distances computed once as an (n,n) matrix, and radii solved by a vectorized over-relaxed Jacobi iteration (r_i = min(wall_i, min_j(d_ij − r_j)) with ω=1.5), plus a final monotone shrink repair for guaranteed feasibility. The ~10x speedup is spent on a multi-seed pipeline (several hex-lattice row patterns, corner-anchored and Halton seeds), each run through a vectorized overlap-relax refinement and a fast coordinate-descent shift search. Data flow: seeds → vectorized refine → shift search → best layout, all operating on whole arrays instead of O(n²) Python loops.
